component.name: ProbeTallTitle
component.script: ' The 80 px tall rowTitleComponentName component of case D; registers itself like ProbeItem. sub onContent() c = m.top.content if c = invalid then return m.top.findNode("label").text = "Tall [" + c.title + "]" if m.serial = invalid m.serial = m.global.serial + 1 m.global.serial = m.serial m.top.id = "title" + m.serial.toStr() nodes = m.global.probeNodes nodes.push(m.top) m.global.probeNodes = nodes p = m.top.getParent() ps = "invalid" if p <> invalid then ps = p.subtype() print "PROBE|life|" + m.top.id + "|first-content|content=" + c.title + " parent=" + ps + " width=" + m.top.width.toStr() + " height=" + m.top.height.toStr() end if end sub
